method: One uniform scale and translation for both rows of the same supplementary master, derived from crown-to-root-attachment body axis; no wing bounds fitted
coordinate_space: selected native-registration-v3 450x400 pixel centers, manual reading from before-body grid; approximately one pixel landmark uncertainty
scale_rule: holding body-axis length divided by average takeoff_start and landing_end body-axis lengths
translation_rule: align average resting-boundary body-axis midpoint to holding body-axis midpoint using the same translation for all twelve frames
preview_policy: Preserve selected preview-v4 whole-action camera for diagnostic candidate; also compute and report genuine recomputed whole-cohort camera without selecting it
acceptance: unselected authored registration candidate; native playback, human visual approval and rights pending
